issues.description: The UML in the problem statement defines the Lecture attributes as private (marked with '-'), but the template Lecture.java declares at least two attributes as public (lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents). The solution implementation uses private attributes. This visibility mismatch can confuse students about whether fields should be accessed directly or via getters/setters and conflicts with the UML and the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template Lecture.java to declare all lecture attributes as private (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) to match the UML and the solution. Keep the getters/setters and constructor as the intended student tasks so students implement accessors rather than access fields directly.
